new_value: {"notes":"Decided by Mark 2026-11-17: (1) an in-chat notice message when a contact's SCID changes, in mimid-agent-jmap; (3) proper JMAP Chat properties for did_webvh status and identity change in jmap-chat-spec and crate-jmap. No mimid-only extra fields. Per AGENTS.md each write to jmap-chat-spec / crate-jmap still needs Mark's OK on the text when it happens."}

Part (1) done in 3cdc553: mimid-agent-jmap stores one plain-text notice Message per room and per (user, pinned SCID, presented SCID) when the agent raises Event::IdentityChanged (SCID changed, or a BasicCredential device for a pinned contact); body names the contact (displayName else user URI), says the identity changed and asks to verify; senderId = the accountId (JMAP Chat has no system sender and mimid-agent-jmap had no convention; a made-up ChatContact would look like a person; the account's own agent wrote it, so it cannot read as from the contact). Idempotent: keyed in the senderMsgId random part (SHA-256 of room/user/SCIDs), rebuilt on restore; a replay or a re-raise at a later Commit stores nothing. Coordinator addition: ChatContact.did = the contact's did:webvh DID (head DID document id), updated with the notice, none for BasicCredential contacts; capability not advertised (decision mimid-1wgh.4.81.29). No mimid-only properties. Test: crates/mimid-agent-jmap/tests/didwebvh_contacts.rs (real server; DIDs from the controller's own log; second Commit re-raises the event and still one notice; mutation without the idempotency key fails with 2). Part (3) (JMAP Chat properties in jmap-chat-spec/crate-jmap) moved to mimid-1wgh.4.81.30. Feedback item 27.
